device: Samsung Galaxy A52s 5G SM-A528B, 1080x2400 at 60 Hz, release arm64 build
method: SurfaceFlinger present times of the Flutter surface (studio/cache/device-2026-11-19/sf.py as on 2026-11-17; the first run with sftime.py, which taps Replay and keeps every frame after it). Reveals are started with "Play reveal" in their dock. A frame is presented only when the picture changes.
powerSaving: On for every run (settings global low_power = 1, read and not changed); P12 measured IX at 50.5-51.3 fps in it and 59.5-60.0 without.
